definitions.explanation: Hands without gloves, tools, or weapons. Emphasizes doing something with nothing but one's own hands.

examples.japanese: {素手|すで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{触|さわ}らないで→触る：00808_sawaru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't touch it with your bare hands.

examples.japanese: {素手|すで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかんだ。
examples.english: I grabbed the fish with my bare hands.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬品|やくひん}→薬品：11055_yakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{扱|あつか}う→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{素手|すで}⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧⟦{手袋|てぶくろ}→手袋：01063_tebukuro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When handling chemicals, use gloves instead of bare hands.

notes:
USAGE:
Used adverbially with ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: {素手|すで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (with bare hands). Implies doing something without the protection or assistance of tools, gloves, or weapons. In martial arts, {素手|すで} means fighting without weapons (unarmed).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {素手|すで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{触|さわ}る→触る：00808_sawaru⟧: to touch with bare hands
- {素手|すで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{戦|たたか}う→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧: to fight bare-handed
- {素手|すで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧つかむ: to grab with bare hands
- {素手|すで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cook with bare hands

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{手|て}ぶら→手ぶら：12755_tebura⟧ (empty-handed) means arriving without bringing anything, while {素手|すで} specifically means bare hands without gloves or tools.
